title: Chicago, the hallway
logline: The Chicago hotel's hallway, invented from the same one sentence: orange carpet, numbered doors, an ice machine's blue at the end. He draws the ice machine from the motel; it's the only thing in the room he's seen.

panels.composition: A hotel hallway with orange carpet and numbered doors receding to an ice machine glowing blue at the far end, one door ajar with orange light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a hotel hallway with orange carpet and numbered doors receding to an ice machine glowing blue at the far end, one door ajar spilling orange light, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The ice machine borrowed from the motel.
